trends.label: AI in Fintech
trends.detail: The integration of AI in fintech is on the rise, with companies like Paytm and PolicyBazaar leveraging AI for personalized customer experiences. This trend matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing demand for AI product managers in the Indian fintech industry.

trends.label: Digital Banking
trends.detail: Digital banking is becoming increasingly popular in India, with banks like HDFC and ICICI investing heavily in digital transformation. This trend is crucial for the candidate as it emphasizes the need for product managers with expertise in digital banking and core banking migration.

trends.label: Conversational AI
trends.detail: Conversational AI is gaining traction in the Indian market, with companies like Google and Microsoft launching AI-powered chatbots for customer support. This trend is significant for the candidate as it underscores the importance of conversational AI skills in product management.

trends.label: Regulatory Compliance
trends.detail: Regulatory compliance is becoming a major focus area for fintech companies in India, with the RBI introducing new guidelines for digital lending and data protection. This trend matters for the candidate as it highlights the need for product managers with expertise in regulated environments and change governance.

trends.label: Product Leadership
trends.detail: Product leadership is evolving in the Indian tech industry, with companies like Flipkart and Amazon emphasizing the importance of product-led growth. This trend is relevant for the candidate as it emphasizes the need for product managers to develop leadership skills and take on strategic roles.

certifications.name: Certified Product Manager (CPM)
certifications.provider: Association of International Product Marketing and Management (AIPMM)
certifications.why: The CPM certification is valued by hiring managers in 2026 as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in product development, launch, and lifecycle management. It is particularly relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like product ownership, backlog management, and release management.

certifications.name: AI Product Manager Certification
certifications.why: The AI Product Manager Certification is worth getting for the candidate as it covers topics like AI product building, prompt engineering, and API integration. It is recognized by top tech companies and demonstrates a product manager's ability to develop and launch AI-powered products.

certifications.name: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
certifications.why: The CSPO certification is highly valued in the Indian tech industry as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in Scrum framework, backlog management, and stakeholder management. It is particularly relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like cross-geo Scrum leadership and change governance.

certifications.name: Fintech Certification
certifications.why: The Fintech Certification is worth getting for the candidate as it covers topics like digital banking, core banking migration, and regulated environments. It is recognized by top fintech companies in India and demonstrates a product manager's expertise in fintech product development.

certifications.name: Certified Data Scientist (CDS)
certifications.why: The CDS certification is valued by hiring managers in 2026 as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in data science, machine learning, and AI. It is particularly relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like AI product building and API integration.

news.headline: RBI Launches Digital Lending
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has launched a new digital lending platform to facilitate online loan disbursal and repayment. This development matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing importance of digital banking and loan origination in the Indian fintech industry.

news.headline: Paytm Acquires Fintech Startup
news.summary: Paytm has acquired a fintech startup to enhance its digital banking and payment capabilities. This acquisition is significant for the candidate as it underscores the growing demand for product managers with expertise in digital banking and core banking migration.

news.headline: Google Launches AI Chatbot
news.summary: Google has launched an AI-powered chatbot to provide customer support and enhance user experience. This development is relevant for the candidate as it highlights the growing importance of conversational AI in product management and customer support.
